# ISO 27001:2022 Annex A Control Matrix

**Project:** arbiter
**Generated by:** arbiter (L3 governance)
**Last updated:** 2026-05-11

This matrix maps all 93 ISO 27001:2022 Annex A controls to project coverage.
Controls marked ✅ are satisfied by arbiter-generated artifacts. Controls marked ❌ require manual implementation.

## Summary

| Section            | Controls | Covered | Gap    |
| ------------------ | -------- | ------- | ------ |
| A.5 Organizational | 37       | 4       | 33     |
| A.6 People         | 8        | 0       | 8      |
| A.7 Physical       | 14       | 0       | 14     |
| A.8 Technological  | 34       | 8       | 26     |
| **Total**          | **93**   | **12**  | **81** |
